example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার বন্ধুকে কান মলা দিয়ে চুপ করিয়ে দিল।
মায়ের কাছে কান মলা খেয়ে ছেলেটি লজ্জা পেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He silenced his friend by wiping his ears, meaning he insulted him sharply.
The boy felt ashamed after getting his ears wiped by his mother, i.e., being humiliated.
note: This idiom metaphorically refers to a verbal scolding or insult, akin to physically cleaning or punishing by the ears in traditional disciplinary contexts.
